title: Pet-Damage Claim Allowance on the Listing Pet Fee — Roamhaven Listings Schedule
content:
# Pet-Damage Claim Allowance

*Allowance schedule for Roamhaven Listings, read against the listing's Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claim history.*

## Rule

On top of the standard pet-fee ceiling, a listing may carry a pet-damage claim allowance, worked out on the day of the pet-fee reset. It rests on the Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claims in the pet damage category that the claims team approved and that were filed on the listing within the pet-claim look-back:

- when **two or more** such claims were filed within the look-back, the pet-damage claim allowance is **$50.00**;
- when **exactly one** was, it is **$20.00**;
- when **none** was, there is no pet-damage claim allowance.

Denied, withdrawn or still open claims never count; only claims the claims team approved are counted. The allowance is added to the listing's pet-fee ceiling.

## Schedule

| Approved pet-damage HostCover claims filed on the listing within the pet-claim look-back | Pet-damage claim allowance |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | $50.00 |
| exactly 1 | $20.00 |
| none | none |

## Counting cases (hypothetical claim histories)

| Claims on the listing within the look-back | Counted | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 1 approved pet-damage claim, 1 denied pet-damage claim | 1 | $20.00 |
| 2 approved pet-damage claims | 2 | $50.00 |
| 3 approved pet-damage claims | 3 | $50.00 |
| 1 approved deep-cleaning claim, 1 withdrawn pet-damage claim | 0 | none |
| 1 pet-damage claim still with the claims team, undecided | 0 | none |
